newsitem.title: CHINA: WEIGHTLIFTING-CHINA SETS TWO MORE WORLD RECORDS.
newsitem.headline: WEIGHTLIFTING-CHINA SETS TWO MORE WORLD RECORDS.

text.p: China's Yang Xia set two world records when she snatched 93.5 kg and totalled 207.5 kg in the women's 54 kg division of the Asian weightlifting championships on Wednesday, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Liu Xiuhua, also of China, set a clean and jerk world record for the women's 54 kg class with a lift of 115.5 kg.
Earlier, China's Wan Jianhui broke the men's 70 kg-category snatch world record at the championships in Yangzhou.
Wan, 24, snatched 163 kg at his third attempt, bettering the existing record of 162.5 kg set by compatriot Zhang Xugang at the Atlanta Olympics in July last year.
China's Xing Fen broke the clean and jerk world mark with a lift of 105.5 kg in the women's 46 kg division on Tuesday. She broke the previous world record of 105 kg held by her compatriot Guan Hong.
